```{r}
#| label: setup-common-index
#| include: false
root <- Sys.getenv("TRI_REPO_ROOT")
run_dir <- Sys.getenv("TRI_RUN_DIR")
output <- Sys.getenv("TRI_OUTPUT_DIR")
if (!nzchar(root) || !dir.exists(run_dir) || !dir.exists(output)) stop("Use saved-run rendering through the launcher.")
for (file in c("bmi_hypercapnia_triangulation.R", "triangulation_reporting.R", "common_index_hypercapnia.R", "common_index_reporting.R")) source(file.path(root, "R", file))
require_tri_packages(c("jsonlite", "digest", "knitr"))
bundle <- read_common_bundle(run_dir)
a <- bundle$analysis
r <- a$results
artificial <- bundle$manifest$mode == "fixture"
knitr::opts_chunk$set(dev = if (knitr::is_latex_output()) "cairo_pdf" else "png")
outcome <- function(x) unname(c(abg = "ABG", any_gas = "Combined", icd = "ICD")[x])
method <- function(x) unname(c(observed = "Observed", mar = "MAR", mnar = "MNAR", matched = "Matched")[x])
window <- function(x) ifelse(x == "encounter", "Encounter", "Index day")
target <- function(x) unname(c(bmi_ge30 = "BMI ≥30", bmi_ge40 = "BMI ≥40", matched_abg = "Matched ABG", matched_any_gas = "Matched combined")[x])
table_out <- function(x, caption) knitr::kable(x, caption = caption, booktabs = TRUE, row.names = FALSE)
contrast_table <- function(rows, identities) cbind(identities, data.frame(
  `Change /1,000 (95% CI)` = common_interval_label(rows, "absolute", FALSE),
  `PIF % (95% CI)` = common_interval_label(rows, "relative", FALSE), check.names = FALSE))
page <- function() if (knitr::is_latex_output()) cat("\n\\newpage\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: status
#| results: asis
cat(if (artificial) "**ARTIFICIAL DATA — all results are simulated for software and layout verification.**\n\n" else "**DRAFT CLINICAL RESULTS — reviewed source declarations passed; scientific and release review remain separate.**\n\n")
if (any(r$source_status == "pending")) cat("**Calendar-day source evidence is pending. Those positions contain no estimates or assessed training/reference counts.**\n\n")
source_policy <- bundle$input_receipt$source_policy_id
if (identical(source_policy, "unadjusted_pco2_v1")) {
  cat("Source policy: **unadjusted PCO₂**, authenticated specimen, 5 < arterial PCO₂ <200 and 10 < venous PCO₂ <250 mm Hg. Temperature-adjusted measurements are excluded from these outcomes. ICD absence denotes no target code in a complete available captured encounter extract.\n\n")
} else {
  cat("Source policy: ", if (artificial) "artificial typed gases; no clinical source acceptance" else "not recorded in this historical bundle; no new source-policy label is assigned", ".\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

## Study question and interpretation

Among adults with a first qualifying BMI ≥30 emergency/inpatient encounter in 2022, how do modeled criterion probabilities change under a one-unit BMI reduction above 30? Arterial and combined arterial/venous criteria are analyzed separately. Common-target projections allow a comparison of evidence definitions while displaying assumptions about unobserved outcomes.

These are model-standardized probability contrasts. They are not incidence reductions, effects of within-person weight loss, or established physiologic prevalence. Equal PIFs do not establish equivalent populations or ascertainment. Absolute and relative changes are both shown.

## Methods

Select the first BMI ≥30 encounter before outcome or covariate completeness. Uncertain earlier membership, conflicting indexes and date ties remain unresolved; a later measured admission is never substituted. The common reference comprises resolved indexes with complete inherited adjustment variables. Patients outside that reference remain visible in cohort accounting.

Use unchanged legacy derived BMI and linear logistic models with BMI, age, sex, race/ethnicity and geographic region. Shift observed BMI >30 by exactly 1 kg/m²; BMI =30 stays unchanged, with no floor. The BMI ≥40 sensitivity restricts those same indexes and reuses the primary fitted models.

ABG requires PaCO~2~ ≥45 mm Hg; combined gas requires PaCO~2~ ≥45 or PvCO~2~ ≥50 among available usable results. A combined negative does not establish that an unmeasured specimen is negative. Encounter maxima are primary; index-calendar-day maxima are sensitivities. Calendar-day does not mean elapsed 24 hours or a standardized testing schedule. Missing/unusable results remain unknown.

Observed benchmarks average over outcome-observed cases. Conditional missing-at-random (MAR) projections average the outcome model over the common reference. Demographics alone may not account for informative ordering, specimen choice or frequency; MAR is an assumption benchmark, not a validated correction.

For unobserved outcomes, the exploratory pattern-mixture model is:

$$
\operatorname{logit}q_0(B,L)=\widehat\eta(B,L)+\log(r)+\log(g)(B-40)/5.
$$

Cross missing-versus-observed odds ratios at BMI 40 of 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2 and 4 with relative odds-gradient multipliers per five BMI units of 0.5, 1 and 2. Evaluate this rule at shifted BMI as well; observation membership remains fixed. The r=g=1 anchor reproduces MAR. These parameters are not identified by observed outcomes and their ranges are not clinically validated bounds.

PIF is 1 − mean shifted probability / mean observed probability. Absolute differences are also reported per 1,000 indexed patients. Pointwise 95% delta-method intervals use the full coefficient covariance, holding empirical references, observation status and sensitivity parameters fixed. Their precision does not quantify uncertainty about missingness assumptions.

The ICD comparator includes J96.02/J96.12/J96.22/J96.92/E66.2. Each ICD/gas pair uses identical rows with known coding capture and the required gas evidence. The arterial pair requires ABG; the combined pair accepts either specimen. The two pairs may have different populations. E66.2 includes obesity-containing ascertainment.

## Population accounting

```{r}
#| label: population-accounting
counts <- a$population
labels <- c(n_frame_patients = "Confirmed BMI ≥30 patients", n_index_resolved = "Resolved first indexes",
  n_index_unresolved = "Unresolved first indexes", n_membership_uncertain = "Patients with only uncertain membership",
  n_earliest_ties = "Earliest-date ties", n_earlier_uncertainty = "Potentially earlier qualifying encounter",
  n_conflicting_indexes = "Conflicting earliest evidence", n_missing_adjustment = "Resolved indexes missing adjustment",
  n_reference = "Common covariate-complete reference", n_reference_ge40 = "Fixed-index BMI ≥40 subset",
  n_known_icd = "Reference with known ICD capture", n_matched_abg = "Matched arterial/ICD reference",
  n_matched_any_gas = "Matched either-gas/ICD reference")
table_out(data.frame(Measure = unname(labels), N = tri_count(unlist(counts[names(labels)]))), "Cohort and reference populations; uncertain membership is separate from confirmed patients.")
```

## Primary encounter-wide contrasts

```{r}
#| label: primary-probabilities
primary <- r[r$target_id == "bmi_ge30" & r$window == "encounter" & r$method %in% c("observed", "mar"), ]
table_out(data.frame(Outcome = outcome(primary$outcome), Method = method(primary$method),
  `Model N` = tri_count(primary$n_training), `Reference N` = tri_count(primary$n_reference),
  `Unobserved N` = tri_count(primary$n_reference_unobserved),
  `Observed BMI p (%)` = tri_percent(primary$p_observed), `Shifted BMI p (%)` = tri_percent(primary$p_counterfactual), check.names = FALSE),
  "Probability scenarios and distinct model/reference denominators. Observed denotes the BMI scenario, not measured prevalence.")
table_out(contrast_table(primary, data.frame(Outcome = outcome(primary$outcome), Method = method(primary$method))), "Absolute and relative model-standardized contrasts.")
```

## Fixed-index severe-obesity and timing sensitivities

```{r}
#| label: supporting-contrasts
support <- r[r$method == "mar" & !(r$target_id == "bmi_ge30" & r$window == "encounter"), ]
table_out(contrast_table(support, data.frame(Target = target(support$target_id), Outcome = outcome(support$outcome), Window = window(support$window))),
  "MAR projections using unchanged primary models; BMI ≥40 is a reference restriction, not a new index or refit.")
table_out(data.frame(Target = target(support$target_id), Outcome = outcome(support$outcome), Window = window(support$window),
  `Model N` = tri_count(support$n_training), `Reference N` = tri_count(support$n_reference),
  `Shifted (%)` = common_number(support$pct_shifted), `Outside BMI support N` = tri_count(support$n_shifted_bmi_outside_support), check.names = FALSE),
  "Support diagnostics. Marginal-range counts do not establish conditional positivity; source-pending counts are unassessed.")
```

## Matched ICD comparisons

```{r}
#| label: matched-comparisons
matched <- r[r$method == "matched", ]
identities <- data.frame(Pair = ifelse(matched$target_id == "matched_abg", "Arterial/ICD", "Either gas/ICD"), Criterion = outcome(matched$outcome))
table_out(cbind(identities, data.frame(N = tri_count(matched$n_reference), `Observed p (%)` = tri_percent(matched$p_observed),
  `Shifted p (%)` = tri_percent(matched$p_counterfactual), check.names = FALSE)), "Within each pair, models use the same encounters; no missing ICD projection is fitted.")
table_out(contrast_table(matched, identities), "Matched-definition contrasts; pairs are overlapping and are not independent replications.")
```

## Observation and model diagnostics

The saved observation-by-BMI table reports both evidence availability and positivity. Observation patterns distinguish specimen availability from testing flags. “No captured testing evidence” is not proof that testing did not occur. Dates and maxima do not standardize measurement frequency or treatment before measurement.

```{r}
#| label: observation-summary
patterns <- aggregate(n ~ window + evidence_pattern, a$observation, sum, na.action = na.pass)
table_out(data.frame(Window = window(patterns$window), Pattern = patterns$evidence_pattern, N = tri_count(patterns$n)), "Usable gas patterns in the common reference; unavailable source evidence remains pending.")
table_out(data.frame(Model = a$models$model_id, N = tri_count(a$models$n_training), Events = tri_count(a$models$n_training_events),
  `BMI OR` = common_number(a$models$odds_ratio), Status = a$models$status, check.names = FALSE), "Fitted-model diagnostics; the BMI odds ratio is not converted into PIF.")
```

Detailed BMI-bin availability/positivity, age and categorical covariate coverage, model-shape diagnostics and timing-transition counts are retained as aggregate CSVs. Unseen reference categories are nonestimable without silently reducing the target. Shifted BMI outside marginal training support is flagged. Selection, missingness, model shape and causal assumptions remain relevant after technical source qualification.

```{r}
#| label: failures
failed <- unique(r[r$status != "estimated", c("target_id", "outcome", "window", "reason")])
if (nrow(failed)) table_out(data.frame(Analysis = paste(target(failed$target_id), outcome(failed$outcome), window(failed$window), sep = " / "),
  Reason = failed$reason), "Pending or nonestimable analyses; no substitute model or numerical mark is used.")
```

## Reproducibility and source qualification

This report reads a saved, hash-verified version-3 aggregate bundle. Rendering neither opens clinical inputs nor fits models. Clinical qualification requires the intended BMI ≥30 population, original-key and chronology reconciliation, reviewed legacy BMI/adjustment values, gas mappings and coding-capture evidence. Engineering acceptance and artificial success cannot establish those checks.

```{r}
#| label: source-policy-aggregate-audit
#| results: asis
source_audit <- bundle$input_receipt$source_audit
audit_rows <- lapply(names(source_audit), function(domain) {
  values <- source_audit[[domain]]
  if (!length(values)) return(NULL)
  data.frame(Domain = domain, Measure = gsub("_", " ", names(values)), N = unlist(values), row.names = NULL)
})
if (length(audit_rows) && any(vapply(audit_rows, Negate(is.null), logical(1)))) {
  print(table_out(do.call(rbind, audit_rows), "Source preparation audit before index selection. Record counts are not necessarily independent specimens; measures overlap. Encounter counts use original composite keys."))
}
```

The prior frame-specific, BMI-to-40, historical R and Stata tracks retain their own definitions and runnable commands. They are not relabeled as this common-index analysis.
